description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'FormatWithFluencyTest' that tests the functionality of the 'FormatWithFluency' class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It includes setup to load test data from a YAML fixture and a test method verifying that specific input values are correctly formatted to language strings.

classes.name: FormatWithFluencyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the FormatWithFluency class.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by setting up the fixture path, loading test data, and instantiating the FormatWithFluency object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the getFormattedValue method correctly maps numeric IDs to string representations.
